tldr: Mercury in the 8th house: thinking becomes personal through shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change.
body:
With Mercury in the 8th house, this part of you works through shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change. Mercury describes thinking, communication, learning, writing, and the way the mind makes connections. In practice, this brings attention to what you share, owe, merge with, grieve, fear, desire, or struggle to control.

When this placement is supported, you can become more honest about trust, attachment, and what is actually shared. Mercury can become clear language, strategy, curiosity, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening.

When it is strained, control, secrecy, or fear can make closeness feel heavier than it needs to be. The harder pattern can show up as overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around what needs to be said.
gift: clear language, strategy, curiosity, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening expressed through shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change.
challenge: overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around what needs to be said around shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change.
